messages:
maya: Heads-up — monitoring flagged a leaked Helm values.yml in a partner repo. It includes a short-lived AWS key and a Vault token reference. Leaving details here so we can coordinate rotation now. /cc @security-oncall :red_circle:

jordan: Ack. Can you paste the path and a redacted snippet? need to scope blast radius (which environments/services)

maya: Path: `github.com/partner-org/deployments/infra/helm/values-staging.yml`
Redacted snippet: `aws_access_key_id: AKIA***REDACTED
vault_token: s.xxxxxxx`
Affected: staging cluster creds used by partner sync job (service-account: partner-sync-staging).

eli: OK — two priorities: 1) immediate token and key rotation; 2) tighten RBAC for partner-sync-staging to only list/get secrets. Also enable audit logging for Vault and AWS KMS for retention.

security-oncall: Propose rotation window 20m from now (urgent) — 1 hour block. Ops to rotate AWS keys + Vault token, SRE to patch RBAC, security to enable audit logs. I'll own coordination and post status updates. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops: Plan:
1) Revoke old Vault token: `vault token revoke -address=https://vault.redwood.internal s.xxxxxxx`
2) Create new AWS access key for partner-sync role and attach a permission boundary:
```bash
aws iam create-access-key --user-name partner-sync-staging
# then update partner secret in Vault and Helm chart repo secret store
```
3) Rewrap KMS key if customer-encrypted blobs exist: `aws kms recrypt` (we'll run a dry-run first).
I'll push a PR to infra repo to update the secret ref to `secrets/partner-sync/staging` and mark for automated rotation TTL=24h.

jordan: For Vault: use `vault kv metadata put` to force new versioning? Also suggest issuing an ephemeral token for CICD with `vault token create -policy=partner-sync -ttl=1h -orphan` and put that into the k8s secret via kubectl patch.

ops: Good call. Will create ephemeral token and update k8s secret: `kubectl -n partner apply -f partner-sync-secret.yml` (contains the ephemeral token).

eli: Audit logging: enable Vault audit device to GCS bucket `audit-vault-staging` and enable AWS CloudTrail for KMS with `OrganizationTrail`. I will create tickets for compliance to retain logs 90d.

security-oncall: Assignments: ops = rotate keys + update k8s secret (owner: ops), jordan = create ephemeral Vault token + helper script (owner: jordan), eli = enable audit logging and file compliance ticket (owner: eli), maya = notify partner and pause sync job until confirmed (owner: maya). I'll update channel with timestamps.

deploy-bot: [deploy] PR #458 bumped `partner-sync` secret ref and queued a staged rollout to `staging` — CI passed.

maya: Partner notified. They've paused the sync job and will verify pulled commits on their side. Thank you. :white_check_mark:

ops: Rotation done — old AWS key disabled, new key created and secret updated in Vault, KMS rewrap dry-run successful. Will rewrap for real at 30m mark after we confirm no decryption errors.

jordan: Ephemeral Vault token created and deployed to k8s secret. Script at `infra/scripts/issue_ephemeral.sh` with usage notes.

eli: Vault audit device enabled to `gs://audit-vault-staging`. CloudTrail for KMS turned on. Filing compliance ticket: TICKET-4921.

security-oncall: Status update: all tasks in plan complete except final KMS rewrap. Holding 30m to confirm apps. If no issues, will perform final rewrap and close incident.

maya: Verified partner able to resume sync in staging, no auth errors observed.

ops: Performing final KMS rewrap now. Will post when complete.

ops: Final KMS rewrap completed. No failures reported in staging.

security-oncall: Closing loop: incident mitigated, RBAC tightened, ephemeral tokens in place, audit logging enabled, keys rotated. Follow-ups: add automated scan to CI for Helm value leaks (owner: devex), set partner onboarding checklist to require secrets-in-vault check (owner: product).

maya: Thanks everyone. Saving notes to postmortem doc and will schedule a 30-min retro tomorrow. :spiral_notepad:

deploy-bot: [note] postmortem draft created: `/docs/postmortems/2026-03-20-partner-helm-values-leak.md`
